description: CHANGELOG.md parser + lint — Parse a Keep-a-Changelog style CHANGELOG (url = raw markdown or a github.com blob URL, or text=) into structured releases: version, date, yanked flag, sections (Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed...) with items, BREAKING entries and compare links, plus the latest and oldest release and section totals. Filters: since= (releases newer than a version, e.g. what changed since I upgraded), version= (one release), limit= (default 20, max 200). Lints the file: version and date order, duplicate versions, missing dates, empty releases, Unreleased not at top. Offline parsing, no AI. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_changelog_parse
